features: Full-width explorer with map/list/form modes, shared filters, details and paginated results
Multi-region file creation trends and table display
Server-calculated property distribution and current/previous performance
Superadmin aggregate request and contract reports; ordinary role-scoped recent lists retained for offices
constraints: Exact coordinates are displayed only when authorized and recorded; approximate city/district/neighborhood precision is identified.
Map points are limited to 500 per filtered response; paginated lists include all matching rows and unmapped records.
Multi-region records can contribute to several geographic groups; report totals are counted once.
Contracts without a linked property are excluded from property-type, price and area filters.
